desc:
Kontra is a competitive tactical shooter built from the ground up, inspired by classic FPS mechanics, featuring responsive gunplay, advanced movement mechanics, and strategic teamwork.

🎯 Your mechanical skill, crosshair accuracy, and strategy decide each round. Team up with friends to play across competitive maps, clutch opponents, secure the site, and climb the ranks to prove who's the master here.
